question: India is the second most populous country with a population of ______, according to the 2011 census data.
solution:
The correct answer is__** 1,210 million.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The population of the nation as per the provisional figures of** Census 2011 is ****1210.19 million **of which **623.7 million (51.54%) are males and 586.46 million (48.46%) are females**
 
• As per the consensus of India 2011, the population of India is 1,210,193,422. According to the numbers,** ****Uttar Pradesh**** is the most populous** state and **Sikkim is the least populous** state in India

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 2011 Census of India or the **15th Indian Census** was conducted in two phases, house listing and population enumeration.
 
• Our Census, Our Future. Th**e Motto of the census of India 2011 was 'Our Census, Our Future.**
 
• It was conducted by** the Ministry of Home Affairs **regarding census in India.
